terra.problem: ‘So’ makes their idolatry the reason God led them into the wilderness. The verses say He resolved to pour out His wrath, but acted for the sake of His name.

The verses do not identify those who sacrificed in the land as the children sworn against; they call them Israel’s fathers. Nor do they say the sacrifices were all made at a single place called Bamah: Bamah is the name given to the high place.
